jp: 労働エナジーを配合した飲料。元気を前借りする効能があり、スタミナ消費もしくは労働や搾乳による生命力低下を一度だけ防止する。飲みすぎると健康を損なうというウワサがあるが、少なくとも現代のイルヴァにそこまで貧弱な生物は存在しない。\n#～飲めるのみもの、飲めないのみもの～
jp_grezzo: "労働エナジーを配合した飲料。元気を前借りする効能があり、スタミナ消費もしくは労働や搾乳による生命力低下を一度だけ防止する。飲みすぎると健康を損なうというウワサがあるが、少なくとも現代のイルヴァにそこまで貧弱な生物は存在しない。\n#～飲めるのみもの、飲めないのみもの～"
en: A beverage containing toil-energy. It has the effect of borrowing energy in advance and prevents stamina consumption or a one-time reduction in lifespan due to labor or milking. There are rumors that drinking too much of it can damage one's health, but at least no creature is that poor in the modern Ylva.\n#~Drinks to Drink, Drinks Not to Drink~
en_grezzo: "A beverage containing toil-energy. It has the effect of borrowing energy in advance and prevents stamina consumption or a one-time reduction in lifespan due to labor or milking. There are rumors that drinking too much of it can damage one's health, but at least no creature is that poor in the modern Ylva.\n#~Drinks to Drink, Drinks Not to Drink~"
it: Bevanda a base di Energia da Lavoro. Anticipa le forze, e impedisce una volta sola che gli SP calino o che la vita scenda per il lavoro o la mungitura. Si dice che a berne troppa si rovini la salute, ma nell'Irva di oggi non esiste creatura tanto gracile.\n#~Bevande da Bere e Bevande da Non Bere~

jp: いくつもの苦しみを詰め込んだ上級ポーション。よほどの強敵でなければこれ１本で無力化できるだろう。\n#～飲めるのみもの、飲めないのみもの～
jp_grezzo: "いくつもの苦しみを詰め込んだ上級ポーション。よほどの強敵でなければこれ１本で無力化できるだろう。\n#～飲めるのみもの、飲めないのみもの～"
en: An advanced potion packed with a number of sufferings. If your enemy isn't ver strong, you will be able to neutralise them with one of these.\n#~Drinks to Drink, Drinks Not to Drink~
en_grezzo: "An advanced potion packed with a number of sufferings. If your enemy isn't ver strong, you will be able to neutralise them with one of these.\n#~Drinks to Drink, Drinks Not to Drink~"
it: Una pozione superiore in cui sono stipate sofferenze d'ogni sorta. Se il nemico non è davvero forte, una bottiglia sola basta a renderlo inoffensivo.\n#~Bevande da Bere e Bevande da Non Bere~

jp: 多くの呪いを詰め込んだ上級ポーション。しぶとかった相手が急激に弱るほどに禍々しい。\n#～飲めるのみもの、飲めないのみもの～
jp_grezzo: "多くの呪いを詰め込んだ上級ポーション。しぶとかった相手が急激に弱るほどに禍々しい。\n#～飲めるのみもの、飲めないのみもの～"
en: An advanced potion packed with many curses. It could be ued to rapidly weaken a tough opponent.\n#~Drinks to Drink, Drinks Not to Drink~
en_grezzo: "An advanced potion packed with many curses. It could be ued to rapidly weaken a tough opponent.\n#~Drinks to Drink, Drinks Not to Drink~"
it: Una pozione superiore in cui sono stipate molte maledizioni. È tanto sinistra che l'avversario più tenace si indebolisce di colpo.\n#~Bevande da Bere e Bevande da Non Bere~

jp: 身体能力を一時的に研ぎ澄ます上級ポーション。かなり最近になって製法が確立された新しい薬品だ。\n#～飲めるのみもの、飲めないのみもの～
jp_grezzo: "身体能力を一時的に研ぎ澄ます上級ポーション。かなり最近になって製法が確立された新しい薬品だ。\n#～飲めるのみもの、飲めないのみもの～"
en: An advanced potion that temporarily sharpens physical abilities. It is a new medicine whose formulation has been established fairly recently.\n#~Drinks to Drink, Drinks Not to Drink~
en_grezzo: "An advanced potion that temporarily sharpens physical abilities. It is a new medicine whose formulation has been established fairly recently.\n#~Drinks to Drink, Drinks Not to Drink~"
it: Una pozione superiore che affina per un po' le doti fisiche. È un preparato nuovo, la cui formula è stata messa a punto solo di recente.\n#~Bevande da Bere e Bevande da Non Bere~

jp: \t\t蜂蜜から造られた、上品な黄金色の酒。飲むと肉体から精神が一時的に分離し、辺りを自在に散策できるようになる。\n#～奥深い酒の世界～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t蜂蜜から造られた、上品な黄金色の酒。飲むと肉体から精神が一時的に分離し、辺りを自在に散策できるようになる。\n#～奥深い酒の世界～\n"
en: An elegant golden liquor made from honey. When drunk, it temporarily separates the mind from the body, allowing the drinker to walk freely around the area. \n#~The Wide World of Alcohol~
en_grezzo: "An elegant golden liquor made from honey. When drunk, it temporarily separates the mind from the body, allowing the drinker to walk freely around the area. \n#~The Wide World of Alcohol~"
it: Un liquore d'un elegante color oro, fatto con il miele. A berlo, lo spirito si stacca per un po' dal corpo e si può passeggiare in giro a piacere. \n#~Il Mondo Profondo dei Liquori~

jp: \t\t潔癖症の人に人気の薬品。浄化の力と化学的機序によって病原微生物やウイルスを弱らせ病原性をなくす。滅菌はできないが毒や病気に効果がある。酒と主成分が同じだが、浄化されているため飲んでも酔うことができない。\n#～家庭でできる応急処置～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t潔癖症の人に人気の薬品。浄化の力と化学的機序によって病原微生物やウイルスを弱らせ病原性をなくす。滅菌はできないが毒や病気に効果がある。酒と主成分が同じだが、浄化されているため飲んでも酔うことができない。\n#～家庭でできる応急処置～\n"
en: Popular chemical for germaphobes. Through its purifying power and chemical mechanism, it weakens pathogenic microorganisms and viruses and renders them non-pathogenic. It cannot sterilize, but it is effective against poisons and diseases. Its main ingredient is the same as alcohol, but because it is purified, it cannot be consumed to get drunk. \n#~First aid at home~
en_grezzo: "Popular chemical for germaphobes. Through its purifying power and chemical mechanism, it weakens pathogenic microorganisms and viruses and renders them non-pathogenic. It cannot sterilize, but it is effective against poisons and diseases. Its main ingredient is the same as alcohol, but because it is purified, it cannot be consumed to get drunk. \n#~First aid at home~"
it: Un preparato che va a genio ai maniaci della pulizia. Con la forza della purificazione e con la chimica indebolisce microbi e virus e li rende innocui. Sterilizzare non sterilizza, ma contro veleni e malattie funziona. Ha lo stesso ingrediente principale dei liquori, ma essendo purificato non ubriaca. \n#~Primo Soccorso in Casa~

jp: \t\tシナモンやバニラの風味が特徴的な炭酸飲料。コーラという木の実を当初使っていたことが名前の由来。大量に糖分が入っており、飲み過ぎると太る。飲んだらゲップが出るのは確実。ルートもわからん状態で山に登れば遭難するっていうくらい確実。\n#～飲めるのみもの、飲めないのみもの～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\tシナモンやバニラの風味が特徴的な炭酸飲料。コーラという木の実を当初使っていたことが名前の由来。大量に糖分が入っており、飲み過ぎると太る。飲んだらゲップが出るのは確実。ルートもわからん状態で山に登れば遭難するっていうくらい確実。\n#～飲めるのみもの、飲めないのみもの～\n"
en: Carbonated beverage with a distinctive cinnamon and vanilla flavor. The name comes from the fact that it was initially made from the fruit of a tree called cola. It contains large amounts of sugar and makes you fat if you drink too much. \n#~Drinks to Drink, Drinks Not to Drink~
en_grezzo: "Carbonated beverage with a distinctive cinnamon and vanilla flavor. The name comes from the fact that it was initially made from the fruit of a tree called cola. It contains large amounts of sugar and makes you fat if you drink too much. \n#~Drinks to Drink, Drinks Not to Drink~"
it: Una bevanda gassata dal caratteristico sapore di cannella e vaniglia. Il nome viene dal frutto di un albero, la cola, che all'inizio se ne usava. Contiene molto zucchero: a berne troppa si ingrassa. \n#~Bevande da Bere e Bevande da Non Bere~

en: \"If you drink a cola, you'll burp!! Like how you climb a mountain without where the summit is, you'll run into trouble! You absolutely will! It's inevitable!\" \n#~some weird old guy~
en_grezzo: "\"If you drink a cola, you'll burp!! Like how you climb a mountain without where the summit is, you'll run into trouble! You absolutely will! It's inevitable!\" \n#~some weird old guy~"
it: \"Se bevi una cola, il rutto arriva!! Sicuro come chi va in montagna senza sapere la strada e ci resta! Sicurissimo! Non c'è scampo!\" \n#~un vecchio bizzarro~

jp: \t\t万能ムギの種子を煎じて作ったお茶。茶葉から作られていないためカフェインが入っていない。香ばしさとスッキリした味わいが特徴。血流を改善する効果もある。\n#～飲めるのみもの、飲めないのみもの～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t万能ムギの種子を煎じて作ったお茶。茶葉から作られていないためカフェインが入っていない。香ばしさとスッキリした味わいが特徴。血流を改善する効果もある。\n#～飲めるのみもの、飲めないのみもの～\n"
en: Tea made by infusing the seeds of the all-purpose wheatgrass. Since it is not made from tea leaves, it does not contain caffeine. It is characterized by its savory and refreshing taste. It also improves blood flow. \n#~Drinks to Drink, Drinks Not to Drink~
en_grezzo: "Tea made by infusing the seeds of the all-purpose wheatgrass. Since it is not made from tea leaves, it does not contain caffeine. It is characterized by its savory and refreshing taste. It also improves blood flow. \n#~Drinks to Drink, Drinks Not to Drink~"
it: Un tè fatto con i semi del bannou mugi, tostati e messi in infusione. Non venendo da foglie di tè non contiene caffeina. Ha un gusto tostato e pulito, e migliora anche la circolazione del sangue. \n#~Bevande da Bere e Bevande da Non Bere~

jp: \t\t生物を本能的に警戒させる成分が凝縮された薬剤。歩きながら定期的に周囲へ散布すれば、野生動物の襲撃は回避できるだろう。ほんの少しでも効果がありたっぷり４００マイルは使える。一応飲めるが、身体が警戒を通り越して拒絶反応を起こすのでやめたほうがいい。\n#～飲めるのみもの、飲めないのみもの～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t生物を本能的に警戒させる成分が凝縮された薬剤。歩きながら定期的に周囲へ散布すれば、野生動物の襲撃は回避できるだろう。ほんの少しでも効果がありたっぷり４００マイルは使える。一応飲めるが、身体が警戒を通り越して拒絶反応を起こすのでやめたほうがいい。\n#～飲めるのみもの、飲めないのみもの～\n"
en: This is a concentrated agent with ingredients that instinctively put creatures on alert. If sprayed regularly around the area while walking, wildlife attacks can be avoided. Even a small amount is effective and can be used for 400 miles. It is possible to drink it, but it is best not to, as your body will reject it beyond alarm. \n#~Drinks to Drink, Drinks Not to Drink~
en_grezzo: "This is a concentrated agent with ingredients that instinctively put creatures on alert. If sprayed regularly around the area while walking, wildlife attacks can be avoided. Even a small amount is effective and can be used for 400 miles. It is possible to drink it, but it is best not to, as your body will reject it beyond alarm. \n#~Drinks to Drink, Drinks Not to Drink~"
it: Un preparato che concentra le sostanze con cui gli animali si mettono d'istinto in allarme. Spruzzato di tanto in tanto intorno a sé mentre si cammina, evita gli assalti delle bestie selvatiche. Ne basta pochissimo, e una boccetta dura per 400 miglia buone. Berlo si può, ma il corpo va oltre l'allarme e lo rigetta: meglio di no. \n#~Bevande da Bere e Bevande da Non Bere~

jp: \t\t老廃物や過剰水分から作られた、液体状の排泄物。決して衛生的なものではないが、発酵させると洗濯に使えるというから奥が深い。水薬ではないが一応飲める。…塩分濃度が高いので注意。\n#～夢の廃物利用～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t老廃物や過剰水分から作られた、液体状の排泄物。決して衛生的なものではないが、発酵させると洗濯に使えるというから奥が深い。水薬ではないが一応飲める。…塩分濃度が高いので注意。\n#～夢の廃物利用～\n"
en: Liquid excrement made from waste and excess water. It is by no means hygienic, but when fermented, it can be used for washing clothes. It is not a medicine, but it is drinkable..... Do beware its high salt content. \n#~Magical Ways of Waste Utilization~
en_grezzo: "Liquid excrement made from waste and excess water. It is by no means hygienic, but when fermented, it can be used for washing clothes. It is not a medicine, but it is drinkable..... Do beware its high salt content. \n#~Magical Ways of Waste Utilization~"
it: Escrementi liquidi, fatti di scorie e d'acqua in eccesso. Igienico non lo è affatto, eppure fatto fermentare serve per il bucato: c'è più di quel che sembra. Non è una pozione, ma bere si può... Attenzione però, il sale è parecchio. \n#~Il Sogno di Riusare gli Scarti~

jp: \t\t「ここにおしっこをさせないでください」\n#～根元の濡れた標識～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t「ここにおしっこをさせないでください」\n#～根元の濡れた標識～\n"
en: \"Dare you enter my magical realm?\" \n#~the Whizzard~
en_grezzo: "\"Dare you enter my magical realm?\" \n#~the Whizzard~"
it: \"Non fate pipì qui.\" \n#~Il Cartello Bagnato alla Base~

jp: \t\t心身を一時的に研ぎ澄ます上級ポーション。皇帝でありながら優れた錬金術士だった古の人物が生み出したとされる。\n#～飲めるのみもの、飲めないのみもの～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t心身を一時的に研ぎ澄ます上級ポーション。皇帝でありながら優れた錬金術士だった古の人物が生み出したとされる。\n#～飲めるのみもの、飲めないのみもの～\n"
en: A high-level potion that temporarily hones one's mind and body. Said to have been formulated by an ancient emperor who was also a prodigious alchemist.\n# ~Drinks to Drink, Drinks Not to Drink~
en_grezzo: "A high-level potion that temporarily hones one's mind and body. Said to have been formulated by an ancient emperor who was also a prodigious alchemist.\n# ~Drinks to Drink, Drinks Not to Drink~"
it: Una pozione superiore che affina per un po' corpo e mente. Si dice l'abbia creata un antico personaggio che era imperatore e insieme un ottimo alchimista.\n# ~Bevande da Bere e Bevande da Non Bere~

jp: \t\t飲むと宝石が周囲を舞っているかのような輝きに包まれる水薬。一時的なものだがきらびやかな雰囲気を出すには十分だ。\n#～飲めるのみもの、飲めないのみもの～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t飲むと宝石が周囲を舞っているかのような輝きに包まれる水薬。一時的なものだがきらびやかな雰囲気を出すには十分だ。\n#～飲めるのみもの、飲めないのみもの～\n"
en: This potion envelops the imbiber in a dance of glittering lights, reminiscent of sparkling gems. It's enough to leave a dazzling impression, though it only lasts a short time.\n# ~Drinks to Drink, Drinks Not to Drink~
en_grezzo: "This potion envelops the imbiber in a dance of glittering lights, reminiscent of sparkling gems. It's enough to leave a dazzling impression, though it only lasts a short time.\n# ~Drinks to Drink, Drinks Not to Drink~"
it: Una pozione che, a berla, avvolge in un luccichio come di gemme che danzano tutt'intorno. Dura poco, ma per darsi un'aria sfolgorante basta e avanza.\n# ~Bevande da Bere e Bevande da Non Bere~

jp: \t\t人気の高い嗜好飲料。茶葉を極力発酵させないようにして作られる。精神を落ち着ける他、身体の免疫力を高める、脂肪の燃焼を助けるといった効能がある。\n#～飲めるのみもの、飲めないのみもの～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t人気の高い嗜好飲料。茶葉を極力発酵させないようにして作られる。精神を落ち着ける他、身体の免疫力を高める、脂肪の燃焼を助けるといった効能がある。\n#～飲めるのみもの、飲めないのみもの～\n"
en: Highly popular beverage of choice. It is made by minimizing the fermentation of tea leaves. In addition to calming the mind, it also has the effect of boosting the body's immune system and aiding in the burning of fat. \n#~Drinks to Drink, Drinks Not to Drink~
en_grezzo: "Highly popular beverage of choice. It is made by minimizing the fermentation of tea leaves. In addition to calming the mind, it also has the effect of boosting the body's immune system and aiding in the burning of fat. \n#~Drinks to Drink, Drinks Not to Drink~"
it: Una bevanda voluttuaria molto amata. Si fa lasciando fermentare le foglie il meno possibile. Oltre a calmare l'animo, rinforza le difese del corpo e aiuta a bruciare i grassi. \n#~Bevande da Bere e Bevande da Non Bere~

jp: \t\t人気の高い嗜好飲料。茶葉を完全発酵させて作られる。葉に残留していたマナが発酵の過程で吸収しやすい形に変化しており、ＭＰ回復・疲労回復等の効能がある。\n#～飲めるのみもの、飲めないのみもの～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t人気の高い嗜好飲料。茶葉を完全発酵させて作られる。葉に残留していたマナが発酵の過程で吸収しやすい形に変化しており、ＭＰ回復・疲労回復等の効能がある。\n#～飲めるのみもの、飲めないのみもの～\n"
en: Highly popular beverage of choice. It is made by minimizing the fermentation of tea leaves. The mana remaining in the leaves is transformed into an easily absorbable form during the fermentation process, and is effective for MP recovery, recovery from fatigue, etc. \n#~Drinks to Drink, Drinks Not to Drink~
en_grezzo: "Highly popular beverage of choice. It is made by minimizing the fermentation of tea leaves. The mana remaining in the leaves is transformed into an easily absorbable form during the fermentation process, and is effective for MP recovery, recovery from fatigue, etc. \n#~Drinks to Drink, Drinks Not to Drink~"
it: Una bevanda voluttuaria molto amata. Si fa lasciando fermentare le foglie fino in fondo. Il mana rimasto nelle foglie, con la fermentazione, prende una forma che il corpo assorbe facilmente: ridà MP e toglie la fatica. \n#~Bevande da Bere e Bevande da Non Bere~

jp: \t\tガソリンとも呼ばれる。古代文明では燃料として用いられていたらしい。揮発性が高く、現在のイルヴァの大気環境では短時間で蒸発してしまう。引火して危ないので、どうしても浴びたいなら火の気のないところで。\n#～飲めるのみもの、飲めないのみもの～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\tガソリンとも呼ばれる。古代文明では燃料として用いられていたらしい。揮発性が高く、現在のイルヴァの大気環境では短時間で蒸発してしまう。引火して危ないので、どうしても浴びたいなら火の気のないところで。\n#～飲めるのみもの、飲めないのみもの～\n"
en: Also known as petrol. Used as fuel by ancient civilizations. Highly volatile, it evaporates in a short time in the current atmospheric environment of Irva. Because it is flammable and dangerous, if you must be exposed to it, do so in a place where there is no fire. \n#~Drinks to Drink, Drinks Not to Drink~
en_grezzo: "Also known as petrol. Used as fuel by ancient civilizations. Highly volatile, it evaporates in a short time in the current atmospheric environment of Irva. Because it is flammable and dangerous, if you must be exposed to it, do so in a place where there is no fire. \n#~Drinks to Drink, Drinks Not to Drink~"
it: Detta anche olio volatile. Pare che le civiltà antiche la usassero come carburante. È molto volatile, e nell'aria dell'Irva di oggi evapora in poco tempo. Prende fuoco ed è pericolosa: se proprio ce la si vuole versare addosso, che sia dove non c'è fiamma. \n#~Bevande da Bere e Bevande da Non Bere~

jp: \t\tエッセンシャルオイルとも呼ばれる。大量の植物から抽出する必要があるため高価。揮発性が高く、現在のイルヴァの大気環境では短時間で蒸発してしまう。普通は香料として少量ずつ用いるもの。多量につけると匂いがキツいので、つけすぎないように。引火性もある。\n#～飲めるのみもの、飲めないのみもの～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\tエッセンシャルオイルとも呼ばれる。大量の植物から抽出する必要があるため高価。揮発性が高く、現在のイルヴァの大気環境では短時間で蒸発してしまう。普通は香料として少量ずつ用いるもの。多量につけると匂いがキツいので、つけすぎないように。引火性もある。\n#～飲めるのみもの、飲めないのみもの～\n"
en: Essential oils. Expensive because they must be extracted from large quantities of plants. They are highly volatile and evaporate in a short time in the current atmospheric environment of Irva. It is usually used in small quantities as a fragrance. It has a strong odor when applied in large quantities, so do not apply too much. It is also flammable. \n#~Drinks to Drink, Drinks Not to Drink~
en_grezzo: "Essential oils. Expensive because they must be extracted from large quantities of plants. They are highly volatile and evaporate in a short time in the current atmospheric environment of Irva. It is usually used in small quantities as a fragrance. It has a strong odor when applied in large quantities, so do not apply too much. It is also flammable. \n#~Drinks to Drink, Drinks Not to Drink~"
it: Lo chiamano anche essenza. Costa caro, perché per ricavarlo serve una gran quantità di piante. È molto volatile, e nell'aria dell'Irva di oggi evapora in poco tempo. Di solito si usa a gocce, come profumo: a metterne troppo l'odore diventa pesante, quindi non si esageri. È anche infiammabile. \n#~Bevande da Bere e Bevande da Non Bere~

jp: \t\tねればねるほど色が変わって効能が増すという不思議な水飴。魔女が暇つぶしで長年かけてねりにねりまくった結果、美味すぎて気絶する程になった。\n#～移り変わりゆくティリスの食～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\tねればねるほど色が変わって効能が増すという不思議な水飴。魔女が暇つぶしで長年かけてねりにねりまくった結果、美味すぎて気絶する程になった。\n#～移り変わりゆくティリスの食～\n"
en: Mysterious syrup that changes color and increases in efficacy the more it is kneaded. The witch spent many years kneading it in her spare time, and as a result, it became so delicious that people would faint.\n#~Everchanging Food of Tyris~
en_grezzo: "Mysterious syrup that changes color and increases in efficacy the more it is kneaded. The witch spent many years kneading it in her spare time, and as a result, it became so delicious that people would faint.\n#~Everchanging Food of Tyris~"
it: Uno sciroppo strano: più lo si impasta, più cambia colore e più cresce l'effetto. La strega, per ammazzare il tempo, l'ha impastato e reimpastato per anni, e il risultato è così buono che si sviene.\n#~Il Cibo Mutevole di Tyris~

jp: \t\t果物や野菜、木の実の汁で作られた飲料。素材の栄養を効率的に吸収できる。各人の嗜好に合わせ、数種類を混ぜてミックスジュースにしたり、乳と混ぜたりしてもいいだろう。\n#～飲めるのみもの、飲めないのみもの～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t果物や野菜、木の実の汁で作られた飲料。素材の栄養を効率的に吸収できる。各人の嗜好に合わせ、数種類を混ぜてミックスジュースにしたり、乳と混ぜたりしてもいいだろう。\n#～飲めるのみもの、飲めないのみもの～\n"
en: A beverage made from the juice of fruits, vegetables and nuts. The nutrients of the ingredients can be absorbed efficiently. You can mix several kinds to make a mixed juice or mix it with milk, according to each person's taste. \n#~Drinks to Drink, Drinks Not to Drink~
en_grezzo: "A beverage made from the juice of fruits, vegetables and nuts. The nutrients of the ingredients can be absorbed efficiently. You can mix several kinds to make a mixed juice or mix it with milk, according to each person's taste. \n#~Drinks to Drink, Drinks Not to Drink~"
it: Una bevanda fatta col succo di frutta, di verdura e di frutti degli alberi. Le sostanze nutrienti si assorbono senza sprechi. Secondo i gusti si possono mescolare più qualità per farne un misto, oppure allungarlo con il latte. \n#~Bevande da Bere e Bevande da Non Bere~

jp: \t\t突然自らが空を駆ける鳥になったような気になる水薬。重力を一時的に弱め、体が一時的に軽くなる。\n#～飲めるのみもの、飲めないのみもの～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t突然自らが空を駆ける鳥になったような気になる水薬。重力を一時的に弱め、体が一時的に軽くなる。\n#～飲めるのみもの、飲めないのみもの～\n"
en: This potion imparts a sudden feeling of becoming a bird, soaring through the sky. Temporarily weakens the effects of gravity on the user, and makes the body feel more nimble for a while.\n# ~Drinks to Drink, Drinks Not to Drink~
en_grezzo: "This potion imparts a sudden feeling of becoming a bird, soaring through the sky. Temporarily weakens the effects of gravity on the user, and makes the body feel more nimble for a while.\n# ~Drinks to Drink, Drinks Not to Drink~"
it: Una pozione che d'un tratto fa sentire come un uccello che corre per il cielo. Indebolisce per un po' la gravità, e per un po' il corpo si fa leggero.\n# ~Bevande da Bere e Bevande da Non Bere~

jp: \t\t突然自らの集中力が高まる水薬。頭が冴えた状態になり、眠気にも耐性がつくが頭が良くなるわけではない。\n#～飲めるのみもの、飲めないのみもの～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t突然自らの集中力が高まる水薬。頭が冴えた状態になり、眠気にも耐性がつくが頭が良くなるわけではない。\n#～飲めるのみもの、飲めないのみもの～\n"
en: A potion that instantly sharpens one's ability to concentrate. Though it clears the user's head and wards off drowsiness, it will not make you any smarter.\n# ~Drinks to Drink, Drinks Not to Drink~
en_grezzo: "A potion that instantly sharpens one's ability to concentrate. Though it clears the user's head and wards off drowsiness, it will not make you any smarter.\n# ~Drinks to Drink, Drinks Not to Drink~"
it: Una pozione che d'un tratto alza la capacità di concentrarsi. La testa si fa lucida e dà resistenza al sonno, ma intelligenti non si diventa.\n# ~Bevande da Bere e Bevande da Non Bere~

jp: \t\t人気の高い嗜好飲料。その風味は焙煎の度合いや挽き加減、淹れ方や用いる器具などにより異なり、万人が最善だと思うものは存在しない。乳を混ぜるのも人気。\n#～飲めるのみもの、飲めないのみもの～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t人気の高い嗜好飲料。その風味は焙煎の度合いや挽き加減、淹れ方や用いる器具などにより異なり、万人が最善だと思うものは存在しない。乳を混ぜるのも人気。\n#～飲めるのみもの、飲めないのみもの～\n"
en: A popular beverage of choice. Its flavor varies depending on the degree of roasting and grinding, the brewing method and equipment used, and there is no one best for everyone. Mixing with milk is also popular. \n#~Drinks to Drink, Drinks Not to Drink~
en_grezzo: "A popular beverage of choice. Its flavor varies depending on the degree of roasting and grinding, the brewing method and equipment used, and there is no one best for everyone. Mixing with milk is also popular. \n#~Drinks to Drink, Drinks Not to Drink~"
it: Una bevanda voluttuaria molto amata. Il sapore cambia con il grado di tostatura, con la macinatura, con il modo di prepararlo e con gli arnesi che si usano, e non ne esiste uno che vada bene a tutti. Va molto anche allungato con il latte. \n#~Bevande da Bere e Bevande da Non Bere~

jp: \t\t混ぜることで食品を永久に腐らないようにするが、食事の成長効果が半減する薬品。希釈してかつ食品に混ぜて使うことを想定しており、そのまま飲むと有害。当然既に腐っている物には効果が無いので、アンデッドに飲ませても腐らなくなったりはしない。\n#～飲めるのみもの、飲めないのみもの～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t混ぜることで食品を永久に腐らないようにするが、食事の成長効果が半減する薬品。希釈してかつ食品に混ぜて使うことを想定しており、そのまま飲むと有害。当然既に腐っている物には効果が無いので、アンデッドに飲ませても腐らなくなったりはしない。\n#～飲めるのみもの、飲めないのみもの～\n"
en: When mixed with food, this chemical permanently prevents it from rotting, though its nutritional value will be halved. It's meant to be diluted in food, and is highly toxic when consumed as-is. Naturally, this preservative will have no effect on things that are already rotten, so it will not stop undead from decaying, even if they drink it.\n# ~Drinks to Drink, Drinks Not to Drink~
en_grezzo: "When mixed with food, this chemical permanently prevents it from rotting, though its nutritional value will be halved. It's meant to be diluted in food, and is highly toxic when consumed as-is. Naturally, this preservative will have no effect on things that are already rotten, so it will not stop undead from decaying, even if they drink it.\n# ~Drinks to Drink, Drinks Not to Drink~"
it: Un preparato che, mescolato a un cibo, gli impedisce per sempre di marcire, ma dimezza la crescita che quel cibo dà. Va diluito e mescolato al cibo: bevuto com'è, fa male. Su ciò che è già marcio, naturalmente, non ha effetto: darlo da bere a un non morto non gli impedirà di decomporsi.\n# ~Bevande da Bere e Bevande da Non Bere~

jp: \t\t神々の用いる栄養剤。心身を強化し疲労と眠気を吹き飛ばし、病気すら一発で治す効果がある。ただし、あまりの強烈さに幻覚が見えてくるので注意。\n#～飲めるのみもの、飲めないのみもの～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t神々の用いる栄養剤。心身を強化し疲労と眠気を吹き飛ばし、病気すら一発で治す効果がある。ただし、あまりの強烈さに幻覚が見えてくるので注意。\n#～飲めるのみもの、飲めないのみもの～\n"
en: A nutritional supplement used by the gods. It energizes the mind and body, wipes away drowsiness and fatigue, and even cures illnesses with just a single dose. However, be advised that its extreme potency is known to induce hallucinations.\n# ~Drinks to Drink, Drinks Not to Drink~
en_grezzo: "A nutritional supplement used by the gods. It energizes the mind and body, wipes away drowsiness and fatigue, and even cures illnesses with just a single dose. However, be advised that its extreme potency is known to induce hallucinations.\n# ~Drinks to Drink, Drinks Not to Drink~"
it: Il ricostituente che usano gli dei. Rinforza corpo e mente, spazza via fatica e sonnolenza e guarisce d'un colpo perfino le malattie. Attenzione però: è così forte che si arriva a vedere le allucinazioni.\n# ~Bevande da Bere e Bevande da Non Bere~

jp: \t\t昔の神々が飲んでいたとされる不死の酒を再現したもの。あらゆる食品と相性がよく、拒食症すら忘れるほどに美味。たが再現が不十分であり、希釈しているにも関わらず激しく酔う。\n#～飲めるのみもの、飲めないのみもの～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t昔の神々が飲んでいたとされる不死の酒を再現したもの。あらゆる食品と相性がよく、拒食症すら忘れるほどに美味。たが再現が不十分であり、希釈しているにも関わらず激しく酔う。\n#～飲めるのみもの、飲めないのみもの～\n"
en: In ancient times, the gods were said to have drunk an alcohol that granted immortality; this is a reproduction of that drink. It goes well with all manner of foods, and its delicious flavor can even cure anorexia. However, this replica is imperfect, and even though it's heavily diluted, it will make anyone violently drunk.\n# ~Drinks to Drink, Drinks Not to Drink~
en_grezzo: "In ancient times, the gods were said to have drunk an alcohol that granted immortality; this is a reproduction of that drink. It goes well with all manner of foods, and its delicious flavor can even cure anorexia. However, this replica is imperfect, and even though it's heavily diluted, it will make anyone violently drunk.\n# ~Drinks to Drink, Drinks Not to Drink~"
it: La riproduzione del liquore d'immortalità che si dice bevessero gli dei antichi. Sta bene con qualunque cibo, ed è così buono da far dimenticare perfino l'inappetenza. Ma la riproduzione è imperfetta: per quanto allungato, ubriaca di brutto.\n# ~Bevande da Bere e Bevande da Non Bere~

jp: \t\t災いを封じ込めた上級ポーション。復讐に燃える魔術士が偶然生み出したとされる。\n#～飲めるのみもの、飲めないのみもの～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t災いを封じ込めた上級ポーション。復讐に燃える魔術士が偶然生み出したとされる。\n#～飲めるのみもの、飲めないのみもの～\n"
en: A great calamity has been sealed within this high-level potion. Said to have been created on accident by a wizard burning with revenge.\n# ~Drinks to Drink, Drinks Not to Drink~
en_grezzo: "A great calamity has been sealed within this high-level potion. Said to have been created on accident by a wizard burning with revenge.\n# ~Drinks to Drink, Drinks Not to Drink~"
it: Una pozione superiore che tiene chiusa dentro una sciagura. Si dice l'abbia creata per caso un mago che ardeva di vendetta.\n# ~Bevande da Bere e Bevande da Non Bere~

jp: \t\t空気に触れた状態で衝撃や熱を与えると、小爆発を起こす危険な液体。かつては罪人への制裁に用いられていた。\n#～飲めるのみもの、飲めないのみもの～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t空気に触れた状態で衝撃や熱を与えると、小爆発を起こす危険な液体。かつては罪人への制裁に用いられていた。\n#～飲めるのみもの、飲めないのみもの～\n"
en: A dangerous fluid that, when exposed to air, reacts explosively to heat or physical shocks. It was once used to punish criminals.\n# ~Drinks to Drink, Drinks Not to Drink~
en_grezzo: "A dangerous fluid that, when exposed to air, reacts explosively to heat or physical shocks. It was once used to punish criminals.\n# ~Drinks to Drink, Drinks Not to Drink~"
it: Un liquido pericoloso: esposto all'aria, se prende un urto o del calore fa una piccola esplosione. Un tempo lo si usava per punire i criminali.\n# ~Bevande da Bere e Bevande da Non Bere~

jp: \t\t高名な錬金術師が長年の研究の末に作り出したポーション。その生成法は複雑すぎて他の錬金術師にはよくわからない。\n#～飲めるのみもの、飲めないのみもの～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t高名な錬金術師が長年の研究の末に作り出したポーション。その生成法は複雑すぎて他の錬金術師にはよくわからない。\n#～飲めるのみもの、飲めないのみもの～\n"
en: A potion formulated by a distinguished alchemist after many years of research. Its production process is too complicated for any other alchemist to comprehend.\n# ~Drinks to Drink, Drinks Not to Drink~
en_grezzo: "A potion formulated by a distinguished alchemist after many years of research. Its production process is too complicated for any other alchemist to comprehend.\n# ~Drinks to Drink, Drinks Not to Drink~"
it: Una pozione che un alchimista famoso ha ottenuto dopo anni di ricerche. Il modo di prepararla è troppo complicato perché gli altri alchimisti ci capiscano qualcosa.\n# ~Bevande da Bere e Bevande da Non Bere~

jp: \t\tヴェルニースで古くから作られている伝統的なキャンディ。富豪など特別な人間の間でしか出回っておらず、一般人が口にする機会は普通ない。それどころか見る機会もない。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\tヴェルニースで古くから作られている伝統的なキャンディ。富豪など特別な人間の間でしか出回っておらず、一般人が口にする機会は普通ない。それどころか見る機会もない。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n"
en: This traditional candy has been made in Vernis since the old days. It is only available among the wealthy and other special people, and the general public does not usually have the opportunity to taste it. In fact, it is rare to even see it. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~
en_grezzo: "This traditional candy has been made in Vernis since the old days. It is only available among the wealthy and other special people, and the general public does not usually have the opportunity to taste it. In fact, it is rare to even see it. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~"
it: Una caramella tradizionale, fatta a Vernis da tempo immemorabile. Gira soltanto fra i ricchi e la gente che conta, e alla gente comune non capita di assaggiarla. Non capita nemmeno di vederla. \n# ~Dizionario Fantastico di Irva~

jp: \t\t「お爺ちゃんがいつもくれるキャンディ、とてもクリーミーでおいしいけど…どっちかというとお小遣いのほうが欲しいなぁ」\n#～特別な孫の言葉～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t「お爺ちゃんがいつもくれるキャンディ、とてもクリーミーでおいしいけど…どっちかというとお小遣いのほうが欲しいなぁ」\n#～特別な孫の言葉～\n"
en: \"Grandpa always gives me candy, it's very creamy and delicious... but I'd rather have an allowance.\" \n# ~words of a grand-son~
en_grezzo: "\"Grandpa always gives me candy, it's very creamy and delicious... but I'd rather have an allowance.\" \n# ~words of a grand-son~"
it: \"La caramella che il nonno mi dà sempre è cremosa e buonissima, però... a dirla tutta preferirei la paghetta.\" \n# ~Parole di un Nipote Speciale~

jp: \t\t青い素材で作られた小さな円筒形の物質。肉体を活性化させる食べ物という噂だが、その見た目から進んで食べてみようと思う者はいないようだ。\n#～別冊ヨウィン・未知の知識を追え！～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t青い素材で作られた小さな円筒形の物質。肉体を活性化させる食べ物という噂だが、その見た目から進んで食べてみようと思う者はいないようだ。\n#～別冊ヨウィン・未知の知識を追え！～\n"
en: Small cylindrical substance made of blue material. It is rumored to be a food that activates one's body, but no one seems to be willing to try it because of its appearance. \n# ~The Yowyn Book of Secrt Knowledge!~
en_grezzo: "Small cylindrical substance made of blue material. It is rumored to be a food that activates one's body, but no one seems to be willing to try it because of its appearance. \n# ~The Yowyn Book of Secrt Knowledge!~"
it: Un piccolo oggetto cilindrico fatto di una materia azzurra. Si dice sia un cibo che rimette in moto il corpo, ma con quell'aspetto nessuno pare avere voglia di provarlo. \n# ~Speciale Yowyn: a Caccia del Sapere Ignoto!~

jp: \t\t祭りの出店等で販売される、子供でも飲むことができる舌を騒がす水薬。程良く甘いその味は、飲むだけで何だか疲れが吹き飛ぶようだ。\n#～飲めるのみもの、飲めないのみもの～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t祭りの出店等で販売される、子供でも飲むことができる舌を騒がす水薬。程良く甘いその味は、飲むだけで何だか疲れが吹き飛ぶようだ。\n#～飲めるのみもの、飲めないのみもの～\n"
en: Often sold at festivals, even children can enjoy this tongue-tingling drink. Its refreshing semisweet taste seems to melt away fatigue somehow.\n# ~Drinks to Drink, Drinks Not to Drink~
en_grezzo: "Often sold at festivals, even children can enjoy this tongue-tingling drink. Its refreshing semisweet taste seems to melt away fatigue somehow.\n# ~Drinks to Drink, Drinks Not to Drink~"
it: Si vende alle bancarelle delle feste, e la possono bere anche i bambini: solletica la lingua. È dolce al punto giusto, e a berla pare che la stanchezza voli via.\n# ~Bevande da Bere e Bevande da Non Bere~

jp: \t\t浸したものに耐炎の保護膜を塗布する水薬。あくまでも物品にしか効果がないので、飲んだところで、あなたの内臓はアツアツの物を食べた時に生ずる火傷に何ら抵抗を示さないだろう。\n#～飲めるのみもの、飲めないのみもの～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t浸したものに耐炎の保護膜を塗布する水薬。あくまでも物品にしか効果がないので、飲んだところで、あなたの内臓はアツアツの物を食べた時に生ずる火傷に何ら抵抗を示さないだろう。\n#～飲めるのみもの、飲めないのみもの～\n"
en: Potion that applies a flame-resistant protective coating to the item in which it is immersed. It is only effective on the item, so when you drink it, your internal organs will not show any resistance to the burns that occur when you eat something hot. \n#~Drinks to Drink, Drinks Not to Drink~
en_grezzo: "Potion that applies a flame-resistant protective coating to the item in which it is immersed. It is only effective on the item, so when you drink it, your internal organs will not show any resistance to the burns that occur when you eat something hot. \n#~Drinks to Drink, Drinks Not to Drink~"
it: Una pozione che stende una pellicola resistente alle fiamme su ciò che vi si immerge. Funziona solo sugli oggetti: a berla, le tue viscere non opporranno la minima resistenza alle scottature di quando si mangia qualcosa di bollente. \n#~Bevande da Bere e Bevande da Non Bere~

jp: \t\t自らの肉体を合理的に再構築させる効果を持つ水薬。成分は不明だが、謎のドームの一団が秘密の一端を握っているらしい、ということだけ分かっている。\n#～飲めるのみもの、飲めないのみもの～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t自らの肉体を合理的に再構築させる効果を持つ水薬。成分は不明だが、謎のドームの一団が秘密の一端を握っているらしい、ということだけ分かっている。\n#～飲めるのみもの、飲めないのみもの～\n"
en: A potion that reconstructs the imbiber's body in a logical fashion. Its composition is unknown. All that's known is that a group from a mysterious dome may understand a part of the secret.\n# ~Drinks to Drink, Drinks Not to Drink~
en_grezzo: "A potion that reconstructs the imbiber's body in a logical fashion. Its composition is unknown. All that's known is that a group from a mysterious dome may understand a part of the secret.\n# ~Drinks to Drink, Drinks Not to Drink~"
it: Una pozione che rimette insieme il corpo di chi la beve secondo ragione. Di che cosa sia fatta non si sa; si sa soltanto che il gruppo della cupola misteriosa pare tenere in mano un pezzo del segreto.\n# ~Bevande da Bere e Bevande da Non Bere~

jp: \t\t飲んだ瞬間、自分が今まで積み上げてきた何かが崩れ去っていったかのような感覚に陥る非常に危険なポーション。気をつけるがいい、あなたは今や過去のあなただ！\n#～飲めるのみもの、飲めないのみもの～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t飲んだ瞬間、自分が今まで積み上げてきた何かが崩れ去っていったかのような感覚に陥る非常に危険なポーション。気をつけるがいい、あなたは今や過去のあなただ！\n#～飲めるのみもの、飲めないのみもの～\n"
en: The moment you drink this highly dangerous potion, it will feel as though something you have built up has crumbled away. Beware, for you are now the you-of-the-past!\n# ~Drinks to Drink, Drinks Not to Drink~
en_grezzo: "The moment you drink this highly dangerous potion, it will feel as though something you have built up has crumbled away. Beware, for you are now the you-of-the-past!\n# ~Drinks to Drink, Drinks Not to Drink~"
it: Una pozione molto pericolosa: nell'istante in cui la si beve si ha la sensazione che qualcosa di quel che si è costruito fin lì stia franando. Sta' in guardia: adesso sei il te di ieri!\n# ~Bevande da Bere e Bevande da Non Bere~

jp: \t\t調子に乗って飲みすぎたり、傷んだものを食べてしまったり。その様な際に肉体がとる自衛的行動によって生み出された悲劇の物質。水薬ではないが一応飲める。一応、飲める…。\n#～鉄の胃袋を求めて・完食列伝～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t調子に乗って飲みすぎたり、傷んだものを食べてしまったり。その様な際に肉体がとる自衛的行動によって生み出された悲劇の物質。水薬ではないが一応飲める。一応、飲める…。\n#～鉄の胃袋を求めて・完食列伝～\n"
en: Produced by excessive consumption or eating spoiled food. It is a tragic substance produced by the body's self-protective actions in such cases. It is not a potion, but it is drinkable. Surely.. drinkable... \n#~Iron Stomach: A Complete Diet~
en_grezzo: "Produced by excessive consumption or eating spoiled food. It is a tragic substance produced by the body's self-protective actions in such cases. It is not a potion, but it is drinkable. Surely.. drinkable... \n#~Iron Stomach: A Complete Diet~"
it: Si esagera con il bere, oppure si mangia qualcosa di andato a male: è la materia tragica che il corpo produce difendendosi in quei frangenti. Non è una pozione, ma bere si può. Si può... bere... \n#~In Cerca di uno Stomaco di Ferro: Piatti Finiti~

jp: \t\t「生きている以上吐くことだってあるだろうな。だがな、街の中に吐くことだけは決して許さん。もし俺の眼の前でやってみろ、その場で即座におまえの口に押し戻してやるからな！」\n#～掃除屋『バルザック』の言葉～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t「生きている以上吐くことだってあるだろうな。だがな、街の中に吐くことだけは決して許さん。もし俺の眼の前でやってみろ、その場で即座におまえの口に押し戻してやるからな！」\n#～掃除屋『バルザック』の言葉～\n"
en: \"As long as you're alive, you're going to throw up. But I will never allow you to throw up in the city. If you do it in front of me, I will immediately push it back into your mouth!\" \n#~the Cleaner Balzak~
en_grezzo: "\"As long as you're alive, you're going to throw up. But I will never allow you to throw up in the city. If you do it in front of me, I will immediately push it back into your mouth!\" \n#~the Cleaner Balzak~"
it: \"Finché si è vivi capita anche di vomitare, lo so. Ma dentro la città non lo permetto, mai. Provaci davanti a me, e te lo ricaccio in bocca all'istante!\" \n#~Parole di <Balzak> il custode~

jp: \t\t塩分が過分に含まれた水薬。完全に混ざり切っている為料理に使用することはできないが、町の清掃員達はこれを害虫駆除用に多数携行しているという。\n#～飲めるのみもの、飲めないのみもの～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t塩分が過分に含まれた水薬。完全に混ざり切っている為料理に使用することはできないが、町の清掃員達はこれを害虫駆除用に多数携行しているという。\n#～飲めるのみもの、飲めないのみもの～\n"
en: A potion containing excessive amounts of sodium. Since the salt is completely dissolved, it can't be used for cooking. But town cleaners supposedly carry lots of this substance for use in pest control.\n# ~Drinks to Drink, Drinks Not to Drink~
en_grezzo: "A potion containing excessive amounts of sodium. Since the salt is completely dissolved, it can't be used for cooking. But town cleaners supposedly carry lots of this substance for use in pest control.\n# ~Drinks to Drink, Drinks Not to Drink~"
it: Una pozione con dentro sale in eccesso. Il sale è sciolto del tutto, quindi in cucina non si può usare; pare però che i netturbini della città ne portino con sé parecchie, per sterminare gli insetti nocivi.\n# ~Bevande da Bere e Bevande da Non Bere~

jp: \t\t瓶を通してでも高熱を帯びていると分かる異様な液体。意を決してそれを飲み込んだ時、あなたはそこに過去のあなたを見るだろう！\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t瓶を通してでも高熱を帯びていると分かる異様な液体。意を決してそれを飲み込んだ時、あなたはそこに過去のあなたを見るだろう！\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n"
en: A strange liquid substance, its intense heat can be felt even through the bottle. When gulped down with determination, you might see your past self!\n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~\n
en_grezzo: "A strange liquid substance, its intense heat can be felt even through the bottle. When gulped down with determination, you might see your past self!\n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~\n"
it: Un liquido strano, così caldo che lo si sente attraverso il vetro. Quando ti farai coraggio e lo manderai giù, ci vedrai dentro il te di ieri!\n# ~Dizionario Fantastico di Irva~\n

jp: \t\t名前だけで何やらときめきを感じさせる魅惑の水薬。デリカシーのない者は直接手渡そうとして手痛い平手を食らうが、そういう趣味のある人はご自由に。友達以上の関係には効果がない。\n#～飲めるのみもの、飲めないのみもの～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t名前だけで何やらときめきを感じさせる魅惑の水薬。デリカシーのない者は直接手渡そうとして手痛い平手を食らうが、そういう趣味のある人はご自由に。友達以上の関係には効果がない。\n#～飲めるのみもの、飲めないのみもの～\n"
en: Just the name alone is enough to make one feel a certain kind of crush. Those with no sense of delicacy will get a painful slap if they try to hand it to you directly, but those who have a taste for such things are free to do so. It has no effect on relationships beyond acquaintance. \n#~Drinks to Drink, Drinks Not to Drink~
en_grezzo: "Just the name alone is enough to make one feel a certain kind of crush. Those with no sense of delicacy will get a painful slap if they try to hand it to you directly, but those who have a taste for such things are free to do so. It has no effect on relationships beyond acquaintance. \n#~Drinks to Drink, Drinks Not to Drink~"
it: Una pozione seducente: già solo il nome fa battere il cuore. Chi è privo di delicatezza prova a consegnarla di persona e si becca uno schiaffo sonoro; ma chi ha quel gusto lì faccia pure. Su chi è già più che amico non ha effetto. \n#~Bevande da Bere e Bevande da Non Bere~
